summary: Iteration 18 verification — all 4 bug fixes pass. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases green (date validation, opening_date lock, FIFO allocations, manual validations, preview endpoint). Frontend: 6/6 UI flows green (Add-mode image modal opens, single image viewer, opening-date locked & label, Record Payment modal with manual allocation, embedded PaymentAllocationEditor in edit form, Received tab shows Method + Applied-To columns with per-entry I+P breakdown).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/accounts.py is ~950 lines and is at the upper limit of comfortable file size; the /ledger-enhanced endpoint duplicates a lot of payment-allocation logic already centralised in services/financial.process_payment. Refactor opportunity: extract chronological replay into services/financial so /ledger-enhanced stays in sync with the new sequential-per-entry algorithm (currently it still uses an OLDER aggregate FIFO model with proportional partial-interest distribution, which can drift from the actual stored breakdown after manual allocations).

Manual allocations currently allow amount to exceed an entry's outstanding by 0.01 tolerance — acceptable, but consider explicit floor/ceil rounding everywhere to avoid edge cases on multi-entry allocations.
AccountFormPage.js is reported by main agent to be >1100 lines (embedded PaymentAllocationEditor + image modal + jewellery + form sections). Worth splitting into sub-components for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing ACC000005 (6a3691297e4c7d2ddc6dcc57) and ACC000007 (6a3691297e4c7d2ddc6dcc60). No data mutating tests committed — Record-Payment flow was cancelled before submit, avoided polluting account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 18 verified clean. Backend pytest file `/app/backend/tests/test_iteration18_bug_fixes.py` is suitable for regression. /ledger-enhanced endpoint still uses an older proportional partial-interest algorithm — note for future iterations.
